doc.intent: The default DMG screen preset controls the restrained olive palette, LCD matrix, and STN response. The default DMG shell has no glass map; the picture's reflection on its bezel band comes from the package's own screen reflection (config/bezels/gb-dmg-shell).
doc.extensions: Only what Gambatte declares it opens (gb, gbc, dmg) plus the archives RetroArch unpacks; SemuChecker holds every system to its bound emulators' content extensions. .bin and .gbs (a sound-file format Gambatte cannot play) were dropped; neither occurs in the library.
